		MT-Bench Inf
	

In mt_bench_inf.jsonl we release a corrected version of the MT-Bench questions that we use for evaluation. Each entry has the following fields:

question_id: The question number
category: Which MT-Bench category
turn: A list with the turns
reference [optional]: A reference answer

Below, we show a few examples of questions, the original GPT-4 Reference answer, and our corrected answer:… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/academic-datasets/Inflection-Benchmarks.
reputation: Derived from MT-Bench corrections and used by evaluators of conversational models; reasonably well known in the model-evaluation community.
